question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Maiden speech
solution:
The correct answer is **"First speech"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of the given idiom** "Maiden speech"** is **"First speech".**
 
• **Maiden speech** means the first speech delivered by a parliament member, who is recently appointed.
 
 
• *​Example: New Prime Minister will make his **maiden speech** at 11 am today.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points option, 2 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand here what are idioms.

 
• Idioms are phrases whose exact meaning is quite different from all the words used in the phrase.
 
 
• *Example: He is **over the moon** after being selected for placement*.
 
 
 
• In the above example idiom "**over the moon**" doesn't mean that the person is travelling in space or the moon in reality.
 
• In fact, it means the person is very happy and delighted.
